## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.3.11`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/style/useVueConsistentVBindStyle`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule is **recommended**, meaning it is enabled by default.
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/v-bind-style`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/v-bind-style)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"useVueConsistentVBindStyle": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce a consistent style for `v-bind` in Vue templates.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<div v-bind:foo="bar" />
```

### Valid

```vue
<div :foo="bar" />
<div v-bind="props" />
```

## Options

### `style`

Configures the preferred directive style. Default: `"shorthand"`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"useVueConsistentVBindStyle": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"style": "longhand"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```
